name: IMS File Format & Image Stack Class
definition: A template class and associated file format for storing 3D image stacks (volumes) with associated metadata segments. Solves the problem of persisting and managing multi-image volumetric data with typed pixel storage and extensible metadata.
summary: The IMS file format and Image Stack Class persist 3D volumes with typed pixels and extensible metadata, distinguished by a rigid 16-byte header, memory-mapped loading, and chunked writes.
